Nifty 50 fell 0.39% to 22,600 and decliners led 2,243 to 307
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +2.16% weighted by turnover, against -2.64% for the median stock, a gap of 4.8 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

WESTLIFE FOODWORLD LIMITED rose 6.1% on 98 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Investor Presentation”.

DCM Shriram Industries Limited rose 3.0% on 86 times its usual volume. NSE asked the company to explain the move, “Significant movement in price has been observed in Dcm Shriram Industries Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about…”.

Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited fell 0.9% on 128 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards”.

Jindal Poly Films Limited rose 11.2% on 665 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Jindal Stainless Connects with Stainless Steel Tube Manufacturers, Builds New Opportunities at Tube & Pipe Fair Hyderabad - Tube & Pipe India”.

Standardized operating metrics will alter reported operating margins and peer comparability across capital-intensive sectors.
